get.summary: Describe the instance or build its usage report
get.description: Answers what this otoroshi instance is: the id of its cluster, its version, its java virtual machine, its operating system, the url of its backoffice, its datastore and its environment. With `full=true`, answers instead the anonymous usage report of the cluster (the one the anonymous reporting job sends, whether it is enabled or not): the features it uses, its traffic, its members and the number of its entities. Any admin can call it. Also served as `GET /apis/cluster/node/infos`.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: `true` to answer the anonymous usage report of the cluster instead of the description of the instance

200.description: The description of the instance, or the anonymous usage report with `full=true`

schema.description: The description of the instance, or the anonymous usage report

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

500.description: With `full=true`, a member of the cluster has not sent its statistics yet (a worker registered by `GET /api/cluster/state` before its first quotas update): the report cannot be built

get.summary: Check the health of the instance
get.description: Checks the health of this otoroshi instance and of its components: the datastore, the proxy engine (with a test request), the event store, the certificates, the scripts and the cluster. Answers 200 when the instance is healthy, 503 with the same body otherwise (otoroshi or the datastore not healthy, the proxy engine down, the certificates or the scripts not loaded yet, or a worker that has not loaded the state yet). Any admin can call it.

200.description: The health of the instance and of its components, when every check passes

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

503.description: The health of the instance and of its components, when a check fails: the same body as the 200 one

get.summary: Read the metrics of the instance
get.description: Answers the metrics of this otoroshi instance (jvm, proxy, datastore, plugins...). The format is chosen by the `format` query parameter, or else by the `Accept` header: a json array of metrics (`format=json`, or a client accepting `application/json`, the default), the raw json export of the metric registry (`format=old_json` or `format=old`), or the Prometheus text format (`format=prometheus` or `format=prom`, or a client accepting `application/prometheus` but not `application/json`). Any admin can call it.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format of the metrics: `json`, `old_json` (or `old`), `prometheus` (or `prom`). When absent, the format follows the `Accept` header

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Keeps the metrics whose name matches this pattern, `*` matching any characters (with the Prometheus format, the lines matching it, the dots of the pattern read as underscores)

200.description: The metrics of the instance: a json array of metrics, the raw export of the metric registry with `format=old_json`, or the Prometheus text format

schema.description: The metrics: an array of metrics, or the raw export of the metric registry with `format=old_json` (an array of metrics as well when they are filtered)

oneOf.description: The metrics, one item per metric and group

schema.description: The metrics in the Prometheus text format
schema.example:
# HELP otoroshi_core_proxy_handle_http_request Generated from Dropwizard metric import
# TYPE otoroshi_core_proxy_handle_http_request summary
otoroshi_core_proxy_handle_http_request{quantile="0.5",} 2.1
